labels.assignment: ascending SHA256 then node id; sorted rank modulo count
labels.inner_features: whole inner fold absent from all local/global/posterior/mass/pair/skip seed contexts; stitched for head fit

graph.mask: native frozen pooled predicted argmax equality on non-loop edges; keep all self loops
graph.mask_probability_dtype: native FP32 softmax and member mean
graph.edge_orientation: T[u,v] receives source edge_index[0]=u, edge_index[1]=v; canonical graph is undirected
graph.degree: retained outgoing edges including one self loop; duplicates forbidden
graph.CSR: SciPy CSR, sorted column indices, no duplicates; FP64 values 1/degree[u]
graph.bindings: SHA256 retained int64 edge tensor, CSR indptr/indices and FP64 values before outcome selection

heads.standardization: stitched B training rows only; NumPy population std ddof=0, floor 1e-6
heads.seed_conversion: first 8 SHA256 bytes, big endian, modulo 2^31
heads.loss: multiclass Brier+r*mean squared parameter displacement from initialization
heads.zero_skip: algebraic equality, report FP64 numerical discrepancy; no prediction contamination

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.selected_iterate: best B-fit penalized objective among steps 0..150; strict improvement, earliest exact tie
optimizer.diagnostics: initial, final-update and selected Brier/penalty/objective; gradient L2, selected step, trajectory and wall

budget.batching: C&S configurations share block-field sparse calls; logical costs retain every output field
budget.final_refits: NOT admitted in this development run; later separately freeze/release/count at most6 bank learned fits plus3 single head fits, plus full-VALID fields/C&S and any cache reconstruction
budget.historical_costs: separate original15 base fits, qualification, failed evaluatorV1 and successful evaluatorV2, replay and cacheI/O

selection.finalist: lowest corrected OOF Brier among nine tuned operators
selection.strongest_cheap: per split: best corrected tuned IDs1..5 from own bank and best processed member0 single; ties own ID order then single

metrics.report: every config, fold, block and both banks; raw and corrected
metrics.uncertainty: three split paired differences, mean and range; optional descriptive t df=2, critical=4.303

go_no_go.none_pass: no-go for new fusion confirmation under this protocol
go_no_go.bank_route_reference: both best tuned corrected cheap comparator IDs 1..5 and uncorrected native probability pool

shared_vs_processed_references.contrast: each split independently selected best processed shared versus best processed independent and best processed member0 single
shared_vs_processed_references.interpretation: complete processed pipeline quality; bank-specific prediction masks differ, no causal sharing attribution
shared_vs_processed_references.failure: no shared-superiority or shared-method confirmation proposal; preserve any useful common processor as attributed follow-up

go_no_go.moment_attribution_matched_rho: report all already available same-rho6-vs4 and6-vs5 contrasts in addition to each selected-route contrast; no isolated ingredient claim from mismatched rho
go_no_go.stacker_or_posterior_match_Brier_toleran: mean three-split corrected Brier, tolerance0.001; applies to IDs8 and9
go_no_go.competence: loss by a poorly fitted/unqualified comparator is not evidence of analytic superiority; report training objective and gradient diagnostics

confirmation.before_final_score: seal all selected per-split configs, fitted weights, environment, graph/fold hashes and selector/refit recipe
confirmation.refit: all own VALID anchors; heads fit honest three-outer-fold stitched feature rows
confirmation.eligible_final_population: separately contracted untouched per-split TEST or fresh population

numerics.dtype: FP64 CPU for processing; original bank native FP32 classes retained
numerics.threads: one BLAS/OpenMP/PyTorch intra/inter-op thread; deterministic Torch algorithms
numerics.environment: bind Python/NumPy/SciPy/Torch versions and BLAS configuration at source qualification before fitting
numerics.simplex_solver: batch enumerate all 15 nonempty free faces, increasing free count then lexicographic indices; inactive weights fixed at 0.0125
numerics.QP_objective: w^T A w-2b^T w; moment b=0; projection A=P P^T,b=P posterior
numerics.QP_scale: divide A,b by max(maxabs(A),maxabs(b),1e-12) separately per node
numerics.QP_face_solve: equality-constrained augmented KKT solve; np.linalg.solve for ridge moments, np.linalg.pinv rcond=1e-12 for semidefinite projection
numerics.QP_checks: finite/symmetric/PSD; floor and sum errors <=1e-10; scaled and raw stationarity <=1e-10; retain distinct diagnostics
numerics.QP_selection: lowest feasible scaled objective, differences <=1e-14 treated as numerical ties; lowest squared weight norm, tolerance1e-14; exact remaining ties keep first enumerated face
numerics.QP_roundoff: clip negative excess above floor to zero and renormalize remaining mass0.95; repeat KKT checks
numerics.projection_tie_scope: minimum-norm numerical optimizer over feasible faces; unique probability projection up to reported tolerances; no hidden ridge
numerics.NLL: q_delta=(1-1e-12)*q+1e-12/5; -mean log q_delta[y]; original native uncorrected NLL uses stable uncontaminated log mixture
numerics.log_skip: logsumexp of member log_softmax plus log weights, without exp/log round trip
numerics.failed_attempts: preserve failures/costs; numerical repairs must leave scientific constants fixed and affect all arms consistently

single_control.alias: independent member0, its original selected checkpoint; no new base fit
single_control.graph: own native member0 FP32 predicted classes, same graph/mask/diffusion rule
single_control.features_training: same whole-inner-fold exclusion for anchor mass, same stitched B standardization; no other bank information
single_control.skip: stable member0 log_softmax; zero residual recovers member0
single_control.fit: same 150-update/best-B-objective rule, seed recipe with bank=single_author and operator=10
single_control.selection: head regularizer by corrected OOF Brier; processed single finalist is best of native+C&S and tuned head+C&S, ties native first
single_control.report: all raw/corrected configurations and native/member0 metrics, not only winner

execution.status: specification only; source qualification/admission required separately
